description: Validate, in a single check (no polling), that an element's text or a named attribute matches a pattern. Target by ref or selector. With `attribute` set, reads that attribute; otherwise reads the element's trimmed text. Provide exactly one of: equals, contains, matches_regex. Optional flags (any of i, m, s, u) apply to matches_regex; g and y are rejected as stateful. Returns: { ok, session_id, matched, actual }. Errors: EXPECTATION_FAILED (element found but its value did not match the pattern — details carry expected + actual; a missing attribute reads as actual: null), SELECTOR_NO_MATCH (no element matched — this is one-shot, so a missing element is a precondition failure, not a retry; carries similar_refs), REF_NOT_FOUND (stale ref), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (no/multiple predicates, invalid regex or flags, or ref+selector both/neither).

attribute.description: Attribute name to read (e.g. "value", "aria-label"). Omit to read text.

contains.description: The value must contain this substring.

equals.description: The value must equal this exactly.

flags.description: Optional regex flags (any of i, m, s, u) applied to the regex predicate; g and y are rejected as stateful. Only valid alongside a regex predicate.

matches_regex.description: The value must match this JavaScript regular expression.

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_assert_pattern
title: Assert a text or attribute pattern
